title: A Mixtape for the Recipe
author: Jude Thackeray
blurb: Rafael Joubert, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
